newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen Properties '96 net dives 99 pct.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen Properties '96 net dives 99 pct.

text.p: (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1995 figures)
Earnings per share 0.0025 yuan vs 0.3968 yuan
Net assets per share 2.53 yuan vs 2.51 yuan
Company name: Shenzhen Properties & Resources Development (Group) Ltd.
Note: The results, published in an annual report in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times on Wednesday, were calculated under Chinese accounting standards.
Based on international standards, the firm posted pre-tax profits of 43.74 million yuan for 1996 against 245.25 million yuan in 1995.
A net profit figure for 1996 based on international standards was not available.
The firm proposed no dividend for 1996, pending approval of shareholders at a meeting yet to be scheduled, the firm's 1996 annual report said.
Trading in the company's A and B shares was suspended on Wednesday morning and resumed in the afternoon.
